name: cladedesigns
description: HeyGen HyperFrames video-as-code workspace — HTML + GSAP compositions that render to MP4

scripts.lint:all: npx hyperframes lint main-video && npx hyperframes lint product-promo && npx hyperframes lint kinetic-type && npx hyperframes lint swiss-grid
scripts.render:all: npm run render:main && npx hyperframes render product-promo --output renders/product-promo.mp4 && npx hyperframes render kinetic-type --output renders/kinetic-type.mp4
